name: Menorca Experimental
description: A 19th-century finca of 30 hectares near Cala Llucalari, remade by the Experimental group with interiors by Dorothée Meilichzon. Forty-three rooms — nine with private plunge pools — an infinity pool at the heart of the estate, and a kitchen fed by its own vegetable garden and small island producers. The spirit is an artist's holiday house: colour, calm and serious cocktails at sundown.

practicalInfo.acceso: Estate in the municipality of Alaior, near Cala Llucalari; exact directions on the official website.
practicalInfo.horario: Seasonal opening: check 2026 dates on the official website.
